worldFact.fact: Carved deep into soft volcanic tuff across 18 subterranean levels, the ancient underground city of Derinkuyu sheltered up to 20,000 people and livestock from invading armies, complete with ventilation shafts, wells, stables, churches, and 1,000-pound rolling stone doors operable only from the inside.
